text: Etobicoke York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Etobicoke York Community Council passed By-laws 670-2025 to 675-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Etobicoke York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 676-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
